thread:
marie-cs: Hey team — customer acme-widgets reached out. They consolidated orgs but their $200 trial credits landed on an old/deactivated workspace (org_9876) instead of the new org (org_12345). They need the credits on the active org. Can support reassign or is there a safe migration path?

sam-cs: Do we have the customer's contact/email and the workspace IDs? Also any screenshots of where they see the credit balance?

marie-cs: Requester is kate@acme.com. Screenshots attached in the ticket but summary: billing page for org_9876 shows "Trial credits: $200" while org_12345 shows 0. org IDs from the console: org_12345 (active), org_9876 (legacy). They say both orgs were created under the same email before SSO enforcement.

olivia-eng: This smells like duplicate account auto-linking pre-SSO. If two orgs share an email, promo assignment sometimes followed the first-created org. We can move credits but need backend ops and verification.

raj-engops: For triage, can someone run a quick API check (non-destructive) to show promo ownership? Example command: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_9876/promos"
```
That will show the promo record id and applied_at. Then run same for org_12345. Paste results (sanitized) here.

billing-bot: Policy note: credits issued as trial promos are not user-mutable via the Console. Support can reassign in exceptional cases after identity verification and fraud checks. Need PO or billing contact confirmation for transfers.

marie-cs: I have already confirmed with Kate (billing contact) and attached a signed PO number PO-8892 and the screenshot of the credit in the legacy org. I'll run the two curl checks and paste sanitized output.

support-bot: Created ticket TKT-2026-834 for backend credit reassignment. Priority: P2. Estimated ETA for ops approval + reassignment: ~48 hours depending on verification. Please add any additional artifacts to the ticket.

olivia-eng: Thanks — ops step will require the promo id + applied_at and a note linking to the PO and the billing email. Once verified, backend will zero-out org_9876 promo and re-create equivalent promo on org_12345 with same expiry. I filed the internal runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/credits-transfer 

marie-cs: Pasted sanitized outputs from the promo checks below:
`org_9876 -> promo_id: promo_58c9, applied_at: 2026-03-10T15:22:11Z`
`org_12345 -> no active promos`

raj-engops: Perfect — I attached those to TKT-2026-834 and flagged for ops. Next steps: ops will verify PO and email, set a manual transfer, and then confirm. I'll update this thread when they start the change. :eyes:

marie-cs: Confirmed I added PO and billing contact to the ticket. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 

support-bot: TKT-2026-834 updated: ops acknowledged and queued. ETA still ~48 hours. Case owner: olivia-eng.

olivia-eng: I'll handle the backend once KYC is cleared. If anyone on this thread sees additional linked legacy orgs for this customer, add them to the ticket.

marie-cs: Will do. Closing for now from CS side — will monitor TKT-2026-834 and post updates.
